message.reasoning_content:
I need to determine the additional clockwise angle required for the cat in Image 2 to face the same direction as indicated by the finger in Image 1.

The reference finger is pointing upper-left. Looking at the current object in Image 2, the cat is facing downward.

The directions do not match. I need to calculate the angle difference between facing downward and facing upper-left.

I can see that facing downward is a 270-degree direction. Facing upper-left is a 315-degree direction.

The difference is 315 - 270 = 45 degrees. This is the additional clockwise angle needed.
